python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('sales_data.xlsx', sheet_name='Sales Data', skipfooter=1)
df['Revenue'] = df['Units Sold'] * df['Unit Price']
df['Profit'] = df['Revenue'] - df['Units Sold'] * df['Cost']
df['Margin'] = df['Profit'] / df['Revenue']
print(df[['Product','Region','Revenue','Profit','Margin']].to_string(index=False))
print('Total margin:', df['Profit'].sum()/df['Revenue'].sum())
"
